memo.title: Enterprise RAG Sprint 4 Status Update
summary_points: Backend document ingestion endpoints are complete, but the vector embedding pipeline has a high latency of 4 seconds, which is a major blocker against the 1-second target.
Sneha will attempt to fix the latency issue within 3 days by implementing a sliding window chunking strategy.
The frontend document upload UI is finished, but the search interface is blocked pending the API response schema from the backend team.
QA has completed test cases for ingestion, finding one critical bug (now fixed) and two medium bugs assigned to Karthik.
A client demo is scheduled for April 14th, making the latency issue the biggest risk to the project timeline.
Team members have been assigned to support each other: Arjun will help Karthik with authentication, and Divya will guide Rahul with TypeScript.
key_decisions: Sneha will implement a sliding window chunking strategy to address the embedding latency.
Arjun will guide Karthik on implementing OAuth2 authentication for the new batch upload endpoint.
Sneha must provide the API response schema to Divya by the end of the day.
Divya will be the designated guide for Rahul on any TypeScript-related issues.
blockers: Vector embedding pipeline latency is at 4 seconds per query, significantly above the 1-second target.
The frontend search UI development is blocked until Sneha provides the finalized API response schema.
risks: The high embedding latency issue might not be resolved in time for the client demo on April 14th.
dependencies: Sneha's large-scale testing depends on Karthik delivering the batch document upload endpoint.
Karthik's implementation of authentication for the new endpoint depends on guidance from Arjun.
Divya's completion of the search UI depends on receiving the API response schema from Sneha.
next_steps: Arjun: Send the performance benchmark report to Hariharan by tonight (2025-04-06).
Arjun: Meet with Karthik tomorrow morning to assist with OAuth2 authentication.
Sneha: Share the final API response schema with Divya by end of day today (2025-04-06).
Sneha: Implement and test a sliding window approach to fix latency, to be completed in 3 days.
Karthik: Build the batch upload endpoint by Tuesday.
Karthik: Fix the two open medium-priority bugs by Wednesday.
Divya: Complete the search interface within 2 days of receiving the API schema.
Rahul: Finalize the loading states and error handling on the frontend by Tuesday.
Meena: Begin regression testing on Thursday.
manager_actions: Schedule a mid-week check-in on Wednesday to review progress.
Send a status update email to the client today.
highlights: The FastAPI endpoints for document ingestion are completed and deployed.
The document upload UI is 100% complete.
A critical bug identified during testing has already been fixed.

briefing.briefing_title: Enterprise RAG: Critical Path & Blocker Review for Demo Prep
what_was_discussed: The backend document ingestion endpoints are complete, but the vector embedding pipeline has a high latency of 4 seconds, which is a major blocker against the 1-second target.
The frontend document upload UI is finished, but the search interface is blocked pending the API response schema from the backend team.
QA completed test cases for ingestion, finding one critical bug (now fixed) and two medium-priority bugs which were assigned to Karthik.
A client demo is scheduled for April 14th, making the latency issue the single biggest risk to the project timeline.
what_was_decided: Sneha will implement a sliding window chunking strategy to address the embedding latency, with a 3-day deadline.
Arjun will guide Karthik on implementing OAuth2 authentication for the new batch upload endpoint.
Sneha was to provide the API response schema to Divya by end of day April 6th to unblock frontend development.
Divya will serve as the designated guide for Rahul on any TypeScript-related issues.
what_to_follow_up: Confirm with Sneha that the API schema (Task t4) was shared with Divya, as it was due April 6th and is blocking the search UI (Task t5).
Get a status update from Sneha on the latency optimization (Task t1). Is the sliding window approach showing promise?
Verify with Karthik if Arjun's guidance (Task t3) has unblocked him and what his current ETA is for the batch upload endpoint (Task t2).
Check if Divya is now fully unblocked on the search UI (Task t5) and can meet her 2-day completion goal.
Confirm Rahul is on track to finalize frontend loading states and error handling (Task t8) by Tuesday.
open_questions: What is our fallback plan if the sliding window strategy doesn't reduce latency below the 1-second target by the April 10th deadline?
Assuming the API schema is now shared, is Divya's timeline for completing the search UI still realistic?
Will all critical path tasks (latency fix, batch upload, search UI) be completed in time for Meena to begin regression testing on Thursday as planned?
risks_to_watch: Primary Risk: The vector embedding latency fix (Task t1) is not resolved by April 10th, which will severely impact the client demo on April 14th.
Dependency Risk: A delay in Karthik's batch upload endpoint (Task t2) will prevent Sneha from performing large-scale testing on her latency fix, potentially hiding issues until the last minute.
UI Risk: If the API schema was not provided on time, Divya's search UI (Task t5) will be incomplete for the demo, presenting an unfinished product to the client.
QA Bottleneck: If bug fixes or new features are delayed, Meena's regression testing window will shrink, increasing the risk of undiscovered bugs in the demo build.
suggested_agenda: Status of the vector embedding latency fix from Sneha (Task t1).
Confirm API schema delivery and check unblocking status with Divya (Tasks t4, t5).
Check progress on the batch upload endpoint from Karthik (Task t2) and confirm he is unblocked.
Review status of medium-priority bug fixes (Karthik, t6).
Quick check on frontend finalization with Rahul (Task t8).
Confirm timeline for Meena's regression testing start date.
Discuss and decide on the fallback plan for the latency issue (e.g., smaller embedding model).
